links.comparator_used: Input-output (IO) direct prompting compared with 0-shot chain-of-thought (0-COT) and performed chain-of-thought (P-COT) prompting, across three LLMs
links.outcome: Consistency of LLM-generated recommendation classifications with ESC 2024 AF guideline classifications
links.effect: Claude 3.5 with P-COT had the highest recommendation classification consistency (60.3%); Fleiss kappa across LLM-prompt combinations ranged from 0.449 to 0.763 (moderate to substantial agreement). The abstract gives no IO vs COT numbers for the other models.
links.quote: Claude 3.5 with P-COT prompting had the highest recommendation classification consistency (60.3%).
